scope: Finite independent read-only review of two confirmed sixth-production price-observation/pricing-causality guards, including the first candidate false-positive correction. No model/API/DB/service/Git/source modifications.
whole_actual_corrected_labels: Both retain original news flat / close up under a valid known market baseline; only unsupported prose is corrected.
initial_false_positives_closed: unknown note followed by independent known rising baseline no longer rejected merely because the following clause contains 且
unknown note followed by source-confirmed falling demand no longer rejected by the local pricing-causality guard; source/fact validators remain separate
protected_boundaries: Actual manual “市场反应不明显” remains rejected without an independent comparable announcement response; a general delayed market baseline is not such evidence.
“未见/无法确认/无证据表明” notes, conditionals and expected weak/limited pressure remain valid in their own scope.
Known, source-bound reaction support passes; future, unrelated-alias or merely epistemic source text does not become observed reaction support.
Unknown explicitly introduced as an extra causal premise before a directional conclusion is rejected symmetrically for up/down/flat; unknown itself never supplies sign.
A separate unknown note or concession can coexist with a forecast grounded in a known market or supply/demand premise without requiring “虽然/但”.
No original raw output, terminal status, prediction, diagnostic expected class or validation baseline was changed.
limits: Finite regression and source review, not a proof of universal natural-language correctness.
No new actual model output was generated by this audit. New final-source production prose and translations still require genuine terminal execution and independent review.
The sixth production run remains failed with two accepted P2 brief errors and no delivered detail; zero-call rejection proof does not make it successful.
